purpose: Trigger-regression corpus for the sodax-build front-door / ideation skill. NOT a CI gate today — a fixture for future automated trigger testing. Lives under scripts/ (outside the shipped skills/ tree) so it is never copied into a consumer's install. The dominant failure mode is over-triggering on developers who already decided, so the should-not set is intentionally larger than the should set.

should_trigger.prompt: I'm not a developer — what can I build on SODAX?
I have an idea for a cross-chain app but no idea where to start.
Is SODAX the right tool for my idea?
Help me turn my idea into a spec for a SODAX app.
How could I make money building on SODAX?
I want to let users move money across chains — how would I plan that?
Where do I even start with SODAX?
Can SODAX power a payments product? Walk me through what it'd take.
What kinds of products can you build on a cross-chain DeFi platform like SODAX?

should_not_trigger.prompt: Add a useSwap hook to my React app.
How do I call @sodax/sdk from a Node backend?
Set up an IEvmWalletProvider for signing.
I need a wallet connect button in my dapp.
Why is MoneyMarketService returning a Result error?
Migrate my v1 @sodax/sdk code to v2.
Show me how to do a swap with the Sodax class.
Wire ChainKeys.ETHEREUM_MAINNET into my swap params.
Build a money-market supply page with dapp-kit.
How do I style this button with Tailwind?
Use Uniswap to swap tokens in my app.
Swap 5 USDC to Base for me right now.
should_not_trigger.why: An action now, not a build; the STOP gate sends it to the Builders MCP.
